Brookfield Expands Packaging Portfolio with $1.7 Billion PGP Glass Acquisition
items.snippet: Brookfield Asset Management said it would acquire Indian glass packaging maker PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 bn. PGP Glass makes luxury containers for pharmaceutical, cosmetic and food & beverage companies and works with clients in over 70 countries.

items.title: Flipkart Cuts Logistics Spending by 6% as FarEye Optimises Delivery Operations
items.snippet: Flipkart Wholesale has cut its logistics costs by 6% and vehicle deployment by 8% with the help of FarEye’s AI-powered logistics solution. It also cut vehicle idle time by 10% but kept delivery efficiency consistent across 26 locations and one cross-dock.

items.title: Ashok Leyland Bags Order for 200 Electric Trucks to Support Cement Logistics
items.snippet: OHM Mobility's order to install over 200 electric trucks for cement transportation is speeding up Ashok Leyland's electric commercial vehicle drive. The company is also building an EV ecosystem with localisation of batteries and plans to set up a 4 GWh battery-pack manufacturing facility.
